content:
Aisha: quick PSA for tomorrow's 11am PT panel — please review the candidate takehome, have the rubric handy, volunteer a scribe, and confirm recording/transcript consent with the candidate. @here :white_check_mark:
Priya: weights for this role — are we keeping technical 60 / culture 40? candidate's takehome was a bit uneven.
Samir Patel: I can scribe and run the AV check 10m before. :+1:
Elena: quick question on consent wording — do we say 'may be recorded for hiring debrief' or explicitly mention transcript generation? want to be consistent with privacy.
Maya K: Use this phrasing: "This interview may be recorded and transcribed for internal hiring evaluation and calibration only. Recordings and transcripts will not be shared externally." Link: https://intranet.redwood/ops/interview-consent
InterviewBot: Calendar invite updated — added consent line to description and attached the scribe template.
Sam: small timing Q — candidate is IST, panel is 11am PT. Can we start 5m late to be kind to their timezone? also should we always record if someone joins late?
Aisha: start on time please; we'll include a 3m buffer after intros for remote folks to settle. If candidate joins late, start recording when they join. Samir will handle AV.
Priya: weights confirmed at 60/40 for this hire. I'll add a short rubric note.
Priya: ```
Rubric note: If takehome and live interview diverge significantly, add an explicit comment explaining discrepancy and flag for calibration during debrief.
```
Samir Patel: adding the scribe doc to the calendar now and will ping the channel 10m before the panel. :thumbsup:
Aisha: thanks everyone — last ask: please use the attached scribe template (one line per question) and keep recommendations short (Hire / No Hire / Hold).
